agentId.description: Nonempty identifier of the agent associated with this session.

seq.description: Nonnegative integer revision number for the session state, increased by one with every state-changing tool call.

ts.description: Time of the latest state revision, in Unix epoch seconds.

startedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the session began.

items.description: Activity identifier, or `<activityId>#<index>` for one instance of an instance fan.

frontier.description: Activities currently in progress. An instance fan's branches are named `<activityId>#<index>`, the zero-based collection index; a list fan's plain members appear under their bare identifier. Entries are distinct strings, so a bare activity identifier matches no instance of an instance fan. Empty before the first `next_activity` and after a transition to `__terminal__`; the call that retires a fan's last branch enters the join in the same revision, and a run that ends at an activity named `complete` keeps that activity.

currentTechnique.description: Current technique reference, or an empty string when none is selected.

exit.description: Most recent activity exit, or an empty string when none is recorded.

checkpointId.description: Nonempty identifier of the outstanding checkpoint.

activityId.description: Nonempty identifier of the activity containing the checkpoint.

yieldedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the checkpoint became outstanding.

items.description: Named choice for the ad hoc decision.

options.description: At least two choices for the ad hoc decision.

adhoc.description: Decision details for a checkpoint absent from the activity definition.

activeCheckpoint.description: Outstanding checkpoint and any ad hoc decision details.

additionalProperties.description: Current value of the named variable.

variables.description: Current values keyed by variable name.

additionalProperties.description: Value assigned to the named variable.

variablesSet.description: Assigned values keyed by variable name.

exit.description: Activity exit named by the selected option.

effects.description: Variable assignments and activity exit associated with the response.

additionalProperties.description: Recorded checkpoint choice, response time, and effects.

type.description: Category of the recorded session event.

activity.description: Activity identifier associated with the event.

checkpoint.description: Checkpoint identifier associated with the event.

additionalProperties.description: Value of a named event detail.

data.description: Event-specific values, by `type`. `workflow_triggered` and `workflow_returned`: `{ workflowId, sessionIndex }` of the child. `activity_outcome`: `{ outcome, exit? }`. `progress_published`: `{ published }`. `step_started`: `{ stepId, agentId }`; `step_completed`: `{ stepId, agentId? }`. `checkpoint_response` and `checkpoint_replayed`: `{ optionId }`. `variable_set`: `{ name, value, source }`, with `source` one of `setVariable`, `variables_changed`, `fan_enter` or `yield_checkpoint`; a fan branch's write adds `{ key, instance, member, unit }`, a type mismatch adds `{ declaredType, valueType, typeMismatch: true }`, and a value outside the declared set adds `{ declaredValues, valueOutsideSet: true }`. `variables_seeded`: `{ variables }`, the whole seeded map. `technique_fetched`: `{ techniqueId, stepId?, agentId, chars, delivery }`; `technique_bundled`: `{ techniqueId, stepId, agentId, chars, delivery }`; `resource_fetched`: `{ resourceId, agentId, chars, delivery, bundled? }`, with `delivery` `full` or `unchanged` for all three. `activity_delivered`: `{ agentId, delivery, resolved_techniques, provenance_passes, bundled_steps, spent_chars, eager_budget_chars, response_spent_chars, response_bound_chars, fixed_chars, worker_bundle_chars }`, with `delivery` `full` or `reference`. `activity_dispatched`: `{ agentId, dispatch, chars? }`, with `dispatch` `fresh` or `resume`. `activity_redelivered`: `{ agentId, priorAgentId, chars }`. `activity_usage`: `{ usage, basis, agentId? }`. `batch_refused`: `{ agentId, limit, activities, chars, maxActivities, budgetChars }`, with `limit` `activity_cap` or `delivery_budget`. `workflow_started`, `workflow_completed`, `activity_entered`, `activity_exited` and `checkpoint_reached` carry none.

workflowId.description: Nonempty identifier of the child workflow.

sessionIndex.description: Six-character RFC 4648 base32 identifier of the child session.

triggeredAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the child workflow began.

stepIndex.description: One-based index of the parent step.

triggeredFrom.description: Activity and optional step where the child workflow began.

status.description: Current status of the child workflow.

completedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the child workflow completed.

state.description: Full nested state of the child session.

items.description: Child workflow reference with optional nested state.

triggeredWorkflows.description: Child workflows and their optional nested session state.

planningFolderPath.description: Absolute path of the planning folder containing the session file.

repo.description: Target repository in `owner/repo` form. Fixed once bound: binding a different repository to the session is rejected.

contextMode.description: Agent context model. `persistent`: content already delivered to an agent arrives as a hash reference. `fresh`, the default: content arrives in full unless a call asks for reference delivery, except that `get_activity` sends references for the blocks every activity repeats to an agent returning under the identity its dispatch minted.

additionalProperties.description: Fingerprint of the content associated with this key.
Content keys mapped to fingerprints for one agent.

deliveredContent.description: Content fingerprints grouped by agent identifier, then content key. A key names one whole item, prefixed by its kind: `bundle:<technique-ref>`, `bundle:rules:<hash>`, `bundle:contract:<key>`, `activity_rules:<hash>`, `technique:<id>`, `workflow_bundle:<hash>`, `note:<id>:<hash>`, or `resource:<resource_id>`. An item two calls can deliver keeps one key across both, so a delivery through either collapses the other.

items.description: Artifact identifier, filename, and optional path.

session-file.description: Session identity, progress, variables, decisions, and child sessions.
